card.name: First number in a ratio
card.fires_on: The first number of a ratio or score, just before a colon or hyphen, such as the 1 in 1:1 or the 5 in 5-4. It also fires on the percent or bracket just before such a pair.

modes.label: Ratio in drug or lab text
modes.description: The first number of a mixing, dose or composition ratio, just before the colon.
modes.example: ratio of the milligram dose of bupivacaine HCl solution to bupivacaine liposome injectable suspension does not exceed <<1>>:2.

modes.label: Scores and proportions
modes.description: The first number of a vote count or a proportion written with hyphens.

modes.label: Comparison figure
modes.description: A percent figure in a comparison between two groups, followed by a second figure in brackets.

card.writes: It promotes comparison words like vs and versus, suggesting the text is about to set one quantity against another.
card.plain: It marks the first number in a ratio or score, where the second number or a comparison comes next.
